minAppVersion.description: Plain MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, no pre-release tag. Where "$" accepts a trailing newline (Python), the consumer must reject one.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp ending in Z, e.g. 2026-11-10T20:15:00.000Z. That the day exists in the month needs a "format": "date-time" check or the consumer's own. Where "$" accepts a trailing newline (Python), the consumer must reject one.
